content: The antifungal agent terconazole, chemically described as cis-1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)methoxy]phenyl]-4-isopropylpiperazine, is formulated in a 4% cream preparation. This cream base includes the following excipients: butylated hydroxyanisole, cetyl alcohol, isopropyl myristate, polysorbate 60, polysorbate 80, propylene glycol, stearyl alcohol, and purified water. Similarly, an 8% cream preparation of terconazole, with the same chemical composition, is compounded in a cream base containing the same excipients: butylated hydroxyanisole, cetyl alcohol, isopropyl myristate, polysorbate 60, polysorbate 80, propylene glycol, stearyl alcohol, and purified water. TERAZOL® 3 (terconazole) Vaginal Suppositories are white to off-white in color and are designed for intravaginal administration. Each suppository contains 80 mg of the antifungal agent terconazole, chemically described as cis-1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)methoxy]phenyl]-4-isopropylpiperazine. The suppository base is composed of triglycerides derived from coconut and/or palm kernel oil, which are hydrogenated vegetable oils, along with butylated hydroxyanisole as a stabilizer.
